The Commander Can't Communicate

Download Now


"They say you are not a person at all, only a set of armor the Goddess forgot to empty. That you eat once a year, on the solstice.

And... that you were the last to see her alive."

Ever wonder what Dark Souls would look like if it was a romance visual novel? Wonder no longer, as The Commander Can't Communicate lets you play as the eponymous Commander, a dread knight whose final boss energy has led them to be feared across the realm. Regular combat is a trifle to you, but talking? That's a whole other story. Certain... circumstances have led you to inherit the rulership of a small city. Help the Commander navigate the intricacies of local politics, a growing threat gathering outside the city gates, and maybe, just maybe find a love match along the way. 

For Spooktober, we present to you a teaser of our game's full demo, set to release in Oct/Nov. 

The game teaser features...

  • The opening chapter of a planned full commercial release
  • 76 CGs, creating a cinematic comic-esque visual experience
  • Original music and sound design

The Commander Can't Communicate is a dark fantasy romance. It contains:

  • Depictions of violence and blood, including a stabbing
  • Death, grief, and mourning
  • Body horror
  • Religious persecution and religious thematic content
  • Themes of social anxiety and isolation
  • Suggestive content
Player discretion is advised.
